p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    objs = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    yy, xx = y+dy, x+dx
                    if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and grid[yy][xx] == color and (yy,xx) not in seen:
                        seen.add((yy,xx))
                        stack.append((yy,xx))
            r0, r1 = min(y for y,x in cells), max(y for y,x in cells)
            c0, c1 = min(x for y,x in cells), max(x for y,x in cells)
            objs.append((c0, r0, color, r1-r0+1, c1-c0+1))
    objs.sort()
    out = [[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    top = left = 0
    for i, (_, _, color, oh, ow) in enumerate(objs):
        if i:
            prev_h, prev_w = objs[i-1][3], objs[i-1][4]
            top += prev_h - 1
            left += prev_w - 1
        for r in range(top, min(h, top+oh)):
            for c in range(left, min(w, left+ow)):
                out[r][c] = color
    return out
'''
